name: Geishun! Sukisuki Shoronpo
source:
The annual Xiaolongbao Competition is being held in the city's capital. It seems that whoever makes the best xiaolongbao might be exempt from having to pay the annual tax!?

[Edited/translated from [url=https://kumakumaf.amigasa.jp/ron/ron.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
一年一度的小笼包大赛正在王都举行。听说只要做出最美味的小笼包，就能免交一整年的税金！？

[编译自[url=https://kumakumaf.amigasa.jp/ron/ron.html]官方网站[/url]]
